data.display_address: Loreto 1 A, Loreto, DAMAC Hills, Dubai
data.long_description:
Boasting a central position in DAMAC Hills, Loreto is a prominent project of DAMAC Properties. Loreto 1A is a part of this residential complex that stands 7 floors like other residential buildings in the complex. The building is surrounded by lush green golf courses and has several modern amenities including temperature controlled swimming pool and equipped gym. Other prominent facilities of the building are ample parking spaces, kids play area and high speed elevators.

The building has studios, 1-bed, 2-bed and 3-bed units along with duplexes. All units come with fire extinguishers that minimize any chances of fire related accidents. The development also has a strong security system to eliminate external or internal threats.

DAMAC Hills is a golf community that offers a tranquil living environment with an array of facilities. The neighbourhood has several apartment towers housing for-sale as well as rental flats. Moreover, there are schools, medical centres, shopping spaces, restaurants, retail outlets and a number of other amenities.
